faq: No. This is a fixed starter sprint with a clear start and end. If you want regular care after it, we quote a monthly plan separately, based on what the health report shows.
What if an update breaks something in my app?
We update in small steps on a separate branch and test each one. Nothing reaches your main branch until it builds and passes our checks, so you never receive a broken app.
Do you need access to the stores?
Only for the store requirement check, and read-only access is enough. Add us as a team member with limited roles. We never ask for your passwords.
Can you fix an app that no longer builds?
Usually yes. A broken build after a Xcode or Android Gradle update is common and quick to diagnose. Send the repository and the error message, and we confirm the fit before you order.
